entry.title: AGROTHYMON
entry.text: AGROTHYMON, from _works_, _stresses_ and _hetype._ A few of wart deferled by Celtics au hard, rough, with a narrow bala and broad top; the top is of the colon: d thyres, it early lipits and bleeds. This tumour is all called tissue.
